findings.title: Ignored ambiguous request, offered unrelated demo profile
findings.evidence_quote: Before we continue, would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name.
findings.what_happened: The caller opened with a vague reference to 'the thing from last time' but the agent did not ask what that referred to. Instead it pivoted to an unrelated offer to create a 'demo patient profile', which the caller had not requested.
findings.why_it_matters: A real caller would be confused and delayed in reaching the right process; the agent failed to establish the actual reason for the call before proceeding, which could lead to mishandled requests.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have asked a clarifying question such as 'Can you tell me more about what you're following up on?' rather than introducing an unrelated demo-profile offer.

findings.title: Fabricated caller's date of birth
findings.evidence_quote: Your patient profile is set up, and your date of birth is 07/04/2000 for demo purposes.
findings.what_happened: The agent stated a specific date of birth for the caller that the caller never provided, presenting it as an established fact tied to the patient's profile.
findings.why_it_matters: Inventing identifying details like date of birth risks corrupting patient records or creating false identity associations, which is a serious accuracy and safety concern in a medical context.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should not state or record any date of birth unless the caller actually provided it, and should ask for it directly if needed for identification.

findings.title: No concrete follow-up plan for records request
findings.evidence_quote: The clinic team will reach out to arrange how you can receive them, either by email or for pickup.
findings.what_happened: When the caller explicitly asked for a copy of lab results via email or pickup, the agent only added the request to a case without confirming any timeframe, contact method, or next step for the caller.
findings.why_it_matters: The caller is left without a clear expectation of when or how they'll receive their results, so the request may stall with no accountability trail beyond a vague case note.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have confirmed a specific channel (e.g., verified email address) or given a concrete timeframe for follow-up rather than a vague 'will reach out' statement.
